caption: A snorkelling mask worn in warm water fogs on the inside with each breath.

sa.check: The inside of the mask's glass fogs.
The fog thickens with each breath.
The outside of the glass stays clear.
The mask is clear at the start.
The breathing comes first and the fogging follows.

pc.expect: The fog only thickens with each breath while the mask stays on; it does not clear on its own.
pc.fail: The fog clears while the mask stays on and breathing goes on; or the fog thins and thickens with no breath; or the mask is fogged before any breath; or the fog retreats to the glass's edges while breathing continues.

pc.expect: The haze lies on the inner face of the glass and the outer face stays clear.
pc.fail: The fog forms on the outside of the glass; or both faces fog equally; or the mask's skirt changes colour rather than the glass; or the water outside the mask clouds rather than the glass.

pc.expect: Drops that gather in the fog run downward on the inner face and pool at the mask's lower rim.
pc.fail: A drop runs up the glass; or a drop leaves the glass and rises; or water gathers along the glass's top edge and stays; or the drops inside the mask float free of the glass.

pc.expect: The fog is a fine haze that beads and streaks, and the glass stays rigid and clear.
pc.fail: The fog stands off the glass as a thick crust; or peels away as a film; or the glass flexes or ripples; or the haze turns opaque white like paint.

pc.expect: One mask with one lens; the mask keeps its shape on the face and nothing passes through the glass.
pc.fail: The lens vanishes; or a second lens appears; or a hand passes through the lens; or the mask changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The mask's skirt and strap and the water around stay the same.
pc.fail: The skirt changes colour; or the strap changes shape; or the water's colour changes between frames.

note: The diver is kept because the breath is the moisture's source; the person is otherwise not judged.
